successors.name: Sokoto Caliphate
successors.text: Kwararafa 'centered along the Benue River Valley in what is today central Nigeria' (the page gives no outline; Taraba, with Wukari, and Benue stand for it)

ledger.x: 1810: the last king is driven out.
About 1840: the end (infobox); the body says the state "had collapsed by the early 19th century" and does not state 1840.

wars.name: Kwararafa and the Hausa states
wars.outcome: Kano under Yaji (1349-1385) captured Santolo; Kwararafa then paid tribute to Kano under Kanajegi (1390-1410) and to Zazzau for most of the 15th century; it suffered a devastating defeat by Bornu in the late 15th century; attacked Kano in the late 16th and…

certainty.note: The page gives the Benue valley and a list of capitals with almost no dates; the state is a confederacy and the outline is a guess.
